detail: Read .claude/settings.json: Bash(make:*) allowed; werk/bun-src-cli accept, remove, restore are in the ask list (ask outranks allow in Claude Code, so a personal allow cannot turn it off). Claude Code's own prompt could not be run headless; checked the settings.

Ran src/claude/lint-hook.ts on a .tsx file inside the repo: unused import removed and indentation fixed, exit 0, no output. Then a useEffect with missing dep: file kept, exit 2, stderr names useExhaustiveDependencies. Fixed dep: exit 0, no output.
On a tmp repo copy: links pass; copy of prototyper fails with 'not a link'; restored passes; removed test-scope link fails naming it; extra dev-only plain file does not fail.

Allow list holds only make, werk and bun src/cli.ts commands (no network or outside-write command); no .claude/skills, no .mcp.json, no mcp entry in settings; git check-ignore confirms .claude/settings.local.json is ignored.
Ran src/release/build.ts into a tmp dir: exit 0, four werk-<platform> executables, each .sha256 matches its file.
Copied the executable alone into an empty git folder, started 'serve --port 0', opened / in Chromium: #screen visible, no 4xx responses, JS asset 200, no new non-.werk files beside the executable.
Executable 'help' output is non-empty and identical to 'bun src/cli.ts help' from the checkout; 'find' from the executable exits 0 with no missing-file message.

Executable served an empty project; sent a chat message in Chromium; the fake agent's --append-system-prompt names the executable's real path ('"<exe>" help' etc.) and has no bun or cli.ts; running that command from the folder exits 0. The fake agent cannot run the command itself, so 'agent's answer shows it worked' was checked by running the command myself.

Checked ci.yml statically and ran the local parts: push to main and pull_request triggers; steps make lint, typecheck, test, test-coverage, e2e, smoke as separate steps; make targets run bun install --frozen-lockfile; smoke builds the current-platform executable and reads the map. A real GitHub run and the 'able to be released' mark cannot be run here.

ci.yml has a pull_request trigger and one job with the same steps as a push (tested). 'Merge button only when green' and 'page names the failed step' are GitHub branch-protection and UI behaviour; no test is possible from the checkout.

No way to run a red GitHub run or see a release gate from the checkout. The workflow has no release job or follow-up-ticket hook to test, so the 'cannot be released' and 'basis for a follow-up ticket' parts could not be bound.

ci.yml uses oven-sh/setup-bun with bun-version-file: .bun-version, before make lint; .bun-version holds one exact version. A later pin change is picked up because the file is read each run. The run log itself could not be read.

Ran src/release/smoke.ts against fake executables that print the serving line but answer the map read with 500, and with JSON without nodes: both exit non-zero with the error. ci.yml has smoke as the last step and no continue-on-error, so the run ends red.
